title: Set the fees
headline: Set the *fees*
sub: Copy last term's fees, change one amount, save.

bridge.en: Fees are set. Now every family needs a bill.
bridge.pcm: Fees don set. Now every family need bill.

flow.action: Taps numbers into a calculator, checks a printed fee list, nods and smiles as the total comes out right
flow.setting: the bursar's office at Bright Hill Academy in Ikorodu: a wooden desk under a ceiling fan, grey filing cabinets, green fee ledgers stacked, a window onto the yard

flow.action: Reads a single printed page, taps it once with her pen and gives a small approving nod
flow.setting: the proprietor's office at Bright Hill Academy: a bookshelf, a framed school crest, a term planner on a dark desk, soft morning light
